# Vendored dependencies

## bootstrap.min.css

- **Source**: https://getbootstrap.com/
- **Version**: 5.3.3
- **License**: MIT — https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/LICENSE
- **Unmodified**, downloaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css`
  and self-hosted here because Manifest V3's content security policy doesn't allow loading
  stylesheets from a CDN. Only the CSS is used — no Bootstrap JS/Popper bundle is included, since
  nothing in this extension needs its interactive components (modals, dropdowns, tooltips).

To update: download a newer `bootstrap.min.css` from the same URL pattern with a new version
number, replace this file, and bump the version noted above.
